title: faux orchid with glass vase
text: faux orchid with glass vase. I purchased this one in hopes the orchid flowers would be more realistic than the last one I purchased and they are.  They are really crumpled from the shipping/packing - but them seem to be relaxing some now.  Another issue I had was that the faux moss ball inside the glass jar is glued down and it popped right off when unpacking.  Eh.  The "moss" ball is ok.  I did add some multi colored polished small natural stones to the top (for some weight) and that worked - looks nice.  The colors on the flowers is definitely more natural looking, however the buds are bit too shiny - looking plastic.  But again, it's still better than the really awful one I had before. There are sticks with clips that add to the more realistic look.  One thing I really like is that the strands are drapey... not bushy.  The measurements given are accurate and all things considered, I am keeping it.  The vase bottom is clear glass - as shown in their ad photos.
